PROFILE SUMMARY 
Experienced Banking & Financial Services professional with 11.5+ years of expertise in 
Global Payments, Customer Onboarding, Payment Investigations, Transaction 
Banking, Reconciliation, SWIFT Operations, ISO 20022, Payment Transformation, and 
Project Delivery across global financial institutions including StoneX Financial, 
Commercial Bank of Qatar, JP Morgan Chase, Apex Fund Services, and OSFIN.AI. 
Demonstrated experience in leading end-to-end transformation initiatives, payment 
operations migrations, workflow optimization, automation, stakeholder management, 
business requirement gathering, implementation support, governance, and cross-
functional collaboration. 
Strong exposure to customer onboarding, payment modernization, workflow 
orchestration, cross-border payments, regulatory change, operational 
transformation, project governance, UAT coordination, production deployments, and 
business process improvements. Proven ability to manage global stakeholders, lead 
teams of over 40 FTEs, and deliver strategic banking initiatives across Operations,
